bias.en: Bearish · steadied at $606–610, under the short averages
bias.zh: 看空 · 企稳于 $606–610，仍在短期均线下方

read.en: Meta rose 0.8% on Nov 6 to $610.15, trading $606.82–625.55 on light volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($614.6) and 10-day ($617.6), the falling 200-day ($631.9), the rising 100-day ($633.4) and the falling 30-day ($684.3) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($643.09), and RSI is 37.
read.zh: Meta 11月6日上涨 0.8%，收于 $610.15，盘中区间 $606.82–625.55，成交量偏低。股价位于下行的 5 日（$614.6）和 10 日（$617.6）均线、下行的 200 日（$631.9）、上行的 100 日（$633.4）以及下行的 30 日均线（$684.3）下方。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线下方，处于零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$643.09），RSI 为 37。

read.en: The close edged back above the $606.4–610.1 lows, now support again, but the $625.55 high faded under the 5 and 10-day. Resistance is $614.6–617.6 (5 and 10-day), then $631.9–635 (200 and 100-day, Nov 5 high) and $643.1 (SAR, Nov 4 high). Support is $606.4–610.1, then $600–601.2 and $592.6–594.8. A close above $617.6 would target $632–635; below $606.4, $600.

r.zh: 抛物线 SAR 与11月4日高点 $643.09

s.en: Nov 2 low $606.4; Nov 6 low $606.8; Oct 30 and Nov 3 lows $610.1
Jan 20 and Apr 30 lows $600; Nov 7, 2025 low $601.2
